threshold_rule.ordering: Reuse complete P G2, A G1/G2 and fresh A_prime G1; freeze conditional-top-k method and concrete numeric thresholds; first B G1+G2; only if both pass P-A-B-A performance
threshold_rule.rule: For every metric BvsA <= 1.5 * A_prime_vs_A; no absolute floor; all metrics must pass
threshold_rule.first_divergence: 0-based raw indices retained per case; compare mean and max (256-first_divergence)/256, or zero when identical
threshold_rule.KL: KL(A||candidate) after separately normalizing on shared explicit top-k token IDs with log-sum-exp; excludes probability mass outside shared support; not full-vocabulary KL and not a full-KL lower bound. No probability floor. All other metrics and 1.5 multiplier unchanged.
threshold_rule.prompt_logprobs_probe: Under unchanged production memory settings the longest-input prompt-logprob probe OOMed and terminated A. Engine restored; no teacher-forcing retry. Use user-authorized generated logprobs on identical conditioning prefixes.
threshold_rule.cold: Prefix on; distinct frozen salts per request; require zero prefix-cache hits for all G1 captures
threshold_rule.G2: For each of GSM64,13 fields C1,13 fields C3,8 short before,8 short after: abs(B-A)<=1 and abs(B-P)<=1
threshold_rule.noise: A_prime is a fresh process with the same frozen A manifest; concrete numeric thresholds must be written and SHA recorded before B starts

G1.evidence_note: Censored A target tokens outside candidate top-20 yield lower bounds, not zero errors; a lower bound above a frozen threshold is sufficient to reject. A bound below threshold cannot pass.

A_prime-vs-A.json.scope: KL of distributions normalized on shared explicit top-k support; excludes outside support and is not full vocabulary KL; generated mode only compares identical conditioning prefixes, including the first divergent position.

B-vs-A.json.scope: KL of distributions normalized on shared explicit top-k support; excludes outside support and is not full vocabulary KL; generated mode only compares identical conditioning prefixes, including the first divergent position.
